component.name: VIXGlitcher
component.summary: Dark Neon Lilac mpv Video Player for Arch Linux
Видеоплеер на базе mpv в стилистике тёмного неонового сиреневого

description.p: VIXGlitcher is a fast, native video player built for Arch Linux (Wayland and X11), powered by libmpv under the hood with a pure pitch-black viewport and a custom Dark Neon Lilac GPU interface.
Initial release of VIXGlitcher for Arch Linux (x86_64 AppImage and source).
